title: SKILL: Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent for Logic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.14579v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Logic synthesis optimization poses significant challenges due to exponentially growing search spaces, sparse reward signals, and diverse logic structures. Traditional expert-designed flows lack adaptability, while reinforcement learning (RL) methods often suffer from low sample efficiency and limited interpretability. We introduce SKILL, a Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent that unifies multi-agent LLM reasoning and RL-based environment interaction for automated synthesis optimization. SKILL coordinates three specialized LLMs: GPT-4o for strategic planning, Claude Sonnet 4 for detailed reasoning, and Gemini 2.5 Pro for efficient analysis with a PPO-based RL agent that learns actionable policies through direct interaction with synthesis tools. A novel self-correcting module monitors environment feedback (PDA metrics), detects suboptimal behaviors, and invokes LLM-guided recovery strategies. Evaluations o

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14579v1 公告类型：新公告。摘要：逻辑综合优化由于搜索空间呈指数级增长、奖励信号稀疏以及逻辑结构多样化而面临重大挑战。传统专家设计的流程缺乏适应性，而强化学习方法往往存在样本效率低和可解释性有限的问题。我们引入了SKILL，一种自校正知识引导的迭代大语言模型智能体，它统一了多智能体大语言模型推理和基于强化学习的环境交互，用于自动化综合优化。SKILL协调三个专用的大语言模型：GPT-4o用于策略规划，Claude Sonnet 4用于详细推理，以及Gemini 2.5 Pro用于高效分析，并结合一个基于PPO的强化学习智能体，通过与综合工具的直接交互学习可操作的策略。一个新颖的自校正模块监控环境反馈（PDA指标），检测次优行为，并调用大语言模型引导的恢复策略。评估结果表明...
tldr: SKILL通过融合多智能体大语言模型推理与强化学习环境交互，并引入自校正模块来监控和恢复次优行为，实现了逻辑综合优化的自动化与高效化。
en_tdlr: SKILL unifies multi-agent LLM reasoning with RL-based environment interaction and introduces a self-correcting module to monitor and recover from suboptimal behaviors, enabling automated and efficient logic synthesis optimization.
